[build-system]
requires = ["setuptools>=68", "wheel"]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"

[project]
name = "pomodoro-timer"
version = "0.3.0"
description = "A modern, native macOS Pomodoro timer with a distraction-focused blue/green design."
readme = "README.md"
license = { text = "MIT" }
authors = [{ name = "L3monKenji" }]
requires-python = ">=3.10"
dependencies = [
    "PySide6>=6.6",
]

[project.optional-dependencies]
dev = [
    "pytest>=7.0",
]
package = [
    "pyinstaller>=6.11",
]

[project.scripts]
pomodoro = "pomodoro.cli:main"

[project.urls]
Homepage = "https://github.com/l3montree-dev/pomodoro"

[tool.setuptools.packages.find]
where = ["src"]
